RUPESH JHA 
Business Analyst — Payments & Interbank Clearing | 12+ Years BFSI Domain Expertise 
+91 8800905132 • tavishjha@gmail.com 
PROFILE SUMMARY 
Business Analyst with 12+ years in BFSI, specializing in interbank payments processing across domestic and cross-border clearing (RTGS, NEFT, SWIFT 
MT/MX) and Payment hub ISO 20022 payments modernization. Combines hands-on core banking operations experience (Finacle) — including direct 
oversight of SWIFT payment processing, inward/outward remittances, and RTGS/NEFT batch handling — with 7+ years in Agile BA delivery across 
payments transformation, digital onboarding, KYC/AML, lending, and core banking integration. Skilled at gathering business requirements from 
multiple stakeholder groups (business, compliance, technology, and vendor teams), and translating complex regulatory and payment-scheme 
requirements into BRDs, FSDs, solution specifications, process flows, and developer-ready user stories. Proven track record driving SIT/UAT and 
production readiness on payment-scheme modernization initiatives, including SWIFT MT-to-ISO 20022 MX migration. Seeking to bring this interbank 
payments and clearing domain depth to a Business Analyst role in banking/payments.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Lead Business Analyst — IRIS Software- Bank of Montreal   Nov 2025 – Present | 
Business Analyst for a global bank, leading requirements and delivery for a cross-border payments platform, working closely with business, QA, and 
development teams. 
Global Cross-Border Payments Transformation 
Modernization of the bank's cross-border payment platform to support SWIFT MT and ISO 20022 MX messages for international fund transfers — 
spanning payment initiation, sanctions screening, AML checks, FX validation, correspondent banking integration, payment tracking, and settlement. 
• Gathered business requirements from International Banking and Trade Finance stakeholders; conducted workshops for SWIFT payment process 
improvements. 
• Documented BRD, FRD, user stories, and acceptance criteria; mapped existing SWIFT MT message flows to ISO 20022 MX formats and prepared 
BPMN process flows. 
• Worked with integration teams on SWIFT Gateway, AML, and sanctions screening systems; performed data mapping across Core Banking, 
Payment Hub, and the SWIFT network. 
• Coordinated with Compliance teams on OFAC, FATF, and sanctions validation rules. 
• Supported SIT/UAT, defect triage, and production deployment; maintained the RTM for full requirement traceability. 
• Coordinated with the Product Owner, architects, and development teams across Agile sprints; validated the end-to-end payment lifecycle — 
initiation, validation, screening, routing, settlement, and reconciliation. 
Senior Business Analyst — RBL Bank Ltd Feb 2023 – June 2025 | Noida, India 
Corporate Payments Portal – Cross-Border & Domestic Payments PlaVorm

to define business and functional requirements.

management, maker-checker approvals, FX conversion, and payment tracking. 
• Defined business rules for domestic and cross-border payment processing, including SWIFT MT message validation, payment cut-off times, 
transaction limits, duplicate payment checks, payment hub and beneficiary validation. 
• Collaborated with integration teams to define API requirements between the Corporate Payments Portal, Core Banking, SWIFT Gateway, Payment 
Hub, AML/Sanctions Screening, Treasury/FX, Notification, and General Ledger systems. 
• Worked with Compliance teams to document AML, KYC, OFAC, FATF, and sanctions screening requirements, including payment hold, release, and 
exception-handling workflows. 
• Facilitated backlog grooming, sprint planning, requirement clarification, SIT/UAT support, defect triage, production deployment, and post-
production hypercare. 
• Maintained the Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM) and ensured end-to-end traceability from business requirements through testing and 
production deployment. 
Smart Account Opening Management System — Digital Onboarding PlaVorm 
• Owned end-to-end product lifecycle — backlog of 100+ user stories across 8 sprints with engineering, UX, and compliance teams. 
• Reduced customer onboarding TAT by 60% through digital-first, compliance-embedded workflows; embedded KYC/AML/EDD and RBI compliance 
directly into features. 
• Defined retail banking acceptance scenarios covering role-based access, maker-checker controls, audit trail validation, and exception handling 
across customer servicing touchpoints. 
• Led UAT activities: designed test scenarios for end-to-end onboarding journeys, assessed defect severity, coordinated resolution with 
engineering, and provided business sign-off for production deployment. 
• Reduced customer onboarding TAT by 60% by embedding compliance-first, digital-first workflows — demonstrating direct impact on retail 
operational efficiency and customer experience. 
 
Business Analyst — Bandhan Bank Ltd July 2019 – Jan 2023 | Noida, India 
Domestic Payments Modernization (RTGS & NEFT Processing PlaVorm) — Corporate Banking 
Enhanced the domestic payments platform supporting RTGS and NEFT transactions — covering payment processing, validation rules, beneficiary 
management, transaction monitoring, reconciliation, and integration with Core Banking and RBI payment gateways. 
• Gathered business requirements from Retail Banking Operations; conducted stakeholder workshops for RTGS and NEFT process enhancement. 
• Prepared BRD, FRD, functional specifications, and user stories; documented AS-IS and TO-BE payment workflows. 
• Defined business validation rules for RTGS and NEFT transactions; prepared field-level data mapping documents. 
• Coordinated API integrations between Core Banking, Payment Switch, and RBI interfaces; supported API testing using Postman. 
• Executed SQL queries for data validation; coordinated SIT/UAT with business users and managed defects and requirement clarifications. 
• Built and maintained data validation frameworks and test pipelines across 4 major releases — zero critical defects in production. 
• Conducted 30+ stakeholder interviews/workshops to capture end-to-end payments and banking requirements; translated regulatory

• Collaborated with BI and reporting teams to define dashboards surfacing payments and transaction performance to senior leadership. 
• Documented accounting definitions and GL posting logic, business rules, fee and charge structures, and integration requirements with Core

Payment Analyst — Bandhan Bank Ltd May 2015 – July 2019 | Kolkata, India

inward and outward payment flows. 
• Processed and authorized inward and outward remittances through RTGS, NEFT, and SWIFT channels — validating beneficiary and correspondent 
bank details, transaction limits, and regulatory fields to ensure accurate, timely settlement. 
• Handled day-to-day RTGS/NEFT batch processing and SWIFT message handling as part of branch payment operations, coordinating with the 
bank's central payments team on exceptions and returns. 
• Owned AML, KYC, EDD, and CDD compliance for all client onboarding, building regulatory expertise now embedded into product and 
requirements thinking. 
• Identified operational inefficiencies and drove structured improvement recommendations across payments and transaction processing. 
• Ensured smooth end-to-end processing of Client onboarding, payments, loans and reconciliations, with strong controls to reduce errors and

Payment Associate — Axis Bank Ltd Sept 2012 – Apr 2015 | Delhi, India 
• Operated Finacle core banking (v7) daily for end-to-end processing of Fixed Deposits, Recurring Deposits, and Demand Drafts, building firsthand 
functional knowledge of deposit product workflows, interest calculation, and transaction lifecycle. 
• Handled branch-level inward and outward remittances via RTGS, NEFT, and SWIFT transaction within Finacle — performing beneficiary and

• Processed FD renewals, premature closures, and interest payouts — deep understanding of term deposit business rules, penalty logic, and GL 
entries, now applied to integration requirements and fit-gap analysis. 
• Worked with technology and business teams to enhance operational systems and workflows within the Finacle core banking solution.
